detail.metaDescription: Chemical-free, ecological pest management from Balga Designs — restore native ecosystems and biodiversity in your Northern Rivers garden. Book a free consultation.
detail.whatItIs: A sustainable approach to managing pests that restores native ecosystems and promotes biodiversity within your garden.
detail.whenYouNeed: When pests are affecting your garden and you want them managed without harsh chemicals that damage soil, plants and local wildlife.
detail.whatsInvolved: We assess your garden and apply integrated, ecological pest-management methods suited to your site. Book a free consultation and we will tailor a plan and quote to your garden.
detail.whyBalga: Our methods work with nature, not against it — protecting the biodiversity that keeps your garden resilient over the long term.
